id.description: The threat id; equals the file name.

response.description: The response the threat asks for.

telegraphDelayMs.description: From the telegraph to the opening of the window, in sim ms; `null` = `feel.timing.telegraphDelayDefaultMs`.

windowMs.description: Base response window, in sim ms; `null` = `feel.timing.windowMs`.

minDelayMs.description: Only on a `wait` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): the shortest wait, from the end of the telegraph delay to the signal, in sim ms (story 4.6).

maxDelayMs.description: Only on a `wait` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): the longest wait, from the end of the telegraph delay to the signal, in sim ms, at least `minDelayMs`. The signal falls at one random instant between the two (story 4.6).

signalVerbKey.description: Only on a `wait` threat or a `firm` threat with a `release` (required there, refused elsewhere): key of `strings.fr.json` (`verb.` group) of the verb shown from the signal on (« FILE ! », story 4.6; « LÂCHE ! », story 4.8).

signalIcon.description: Only on a `wait` threat or a `firm` threat with a `release` (required there, refused elsewhere): the glyph drawn in the marker from the signal on, in place of `icon` (stories 4.6, 4.8). The signal is the glyph and the verb, never the colour alone.

feint.description: Only on a `wait` threat (optional there, refused elsewhere): a feint before the signal, « un œil s'entrouvre » (story 4.7). A press on it is an `early` gag like any press before the signal.

minDelayMs.description: The shortest time from the end of `telegraphDelayMs` to the feint, in sim ms.

maxDelayMs.description: The longest time from the end of `telegraphDelayMs` to the feint, in sim ms, at least `minDelayMs`. The feint falls at one random instant between the two, drawn after the signal and independently of it.

minGapMs.description: The shortest time between the feint and the real signal, in sim ms. `maxDelayMs + minGapMs` must fit in the def's `minDelayMs`: the feint always comes first, and a reflex on it can never land in the real window.

icon.description: The glyph drawn in the marker from the feint on, until the signal.

nothingMs.description: Only on a `nothing` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): how long the player must leave the threat alone, from the opening of the window, in sim ms. It is the whole window: no difficulty tier, fatigue or instinct stretches it (story 4.9).

holdUntilMs.description: Only on a `firm` threat without `release` (required there, refused elsewhere): from the opening of the window to the end of the attack, in sim ms. A Firmness is held until then (story 1.23).

release.description: Only on a `firm` threat (optional there, refused elsewhere; the alternative to `holdUntilMs`): a Firmness judged on its release (story 4.8, « Dépose-bombe »). The telegraph is the descent, `windowOpenAt` the final pose, and the response window the window of the release. Needs `signalVerbKey`, `signalIcon` and `feedback.signal`, and a numeric `telegraphDelayMs`.

pressWithinMs.description: How long after the telegraph the press may come, in sim ms, strictly below `telegraphDelayMs`. The sim adds the response window's tolerance (and the input lag) to it, so keep a margin below the descent: a press at the limit can land just short of the final pose.

verbKey.description: Key of `strings.fr.json` (`verb.` group) of the verb shown above the threat (« SOULÈVE ! »). `null` = the default verb of the response, only for a `dodge` response (story 5.1).

icon.description: Glyph drawn in the threat's marker (the client has one per entry).

iconShape.description: Shape of the threat's marker: `circle` goes with `parry`, `triangle` with `dodge` (the pair is the signal, NFR8).

color.description: Colour of the threat's marker, by DESIGN.md token name (`parry` or `dodge`).

telegraph.description: Cue played when the threat is telegraphed.

success.description: Cue played on a successful response.

perfect.description: Cue played on a perfect response.

gag.description: Cue played when the gag is triggered.

signal.description: Only on a `wait` threat or a `firm` threat with a `release` (required there, refused elsewhere): the cue played at the signal, when the window opens (stories 4.6, 4.8).

feint.description: Only on a `wait` threat that has a `feint` (required there, refused elsewhere): the cue played when the feint is given, before the signal (story 4.7).

feedback.description: Cues of `feedback.json` › `cues` the client plays for this threat (story 1.11).

catastrophe.description: How much a gag of this threat raises the catastrophe gauge: the row of `feel.catastrophe.risePct` (`none` = nothing). Must fit the gag (story 3.16).

busyMs.description: How long Papa cannot answer, in sim ms (at most 2000).

dimMs.description: How long the room stays dim after the gag, in sim ms.

oneOf.description: Papa is electrified (cannot answer) and the room goes dim (the outlet).

carryUpMs.description: How long Papa is busy carrying the baby back up, in sim ms (at most 2000).

selfReturnMs.description: If Papa does not fetch him, the baby climbs back by himself after this long, in sim ms.

oneOf.description: The baby is at the bottom of the stairs; Papa must fetch him (the stairs).

pickUpMs.description: How long Papa is busy picking the debris up, in sim ms (at most 2000).

oneOf.description: The pushed object stays on the floor until picked up (the coffee table).
The mischief stays visible until the end of the level and on the photo (the silence).

busyMs.description: How long Papa sleeps, in sim ms (at most 3000).

afterEffect.description: The séquelle of the threat's gag (story 3.15).

cooldownMs.description: Time spent resolved or in gag before the threat is idle again, in sim ms (0 = at once).

gagCryMs.description: When a miss ends in the gag, the baby cries for this long, in sim ms, at least 1000 (story 3.1: one `BabyCrying` per second, +2 % noise each; a shorter cry would be silent). Absent: the gag does not make him cry.

gagNoisePct.description: When a miss ends in the gag, the noise gauge rises by this many points at once (story 9.5: the pot boiling over; no effect in a level with no noise gauge). Absent: the gag makes no noise of its own.

target.description: Where the threat stands: a planned anchor, on Papa (system-spawned, story 1.19), on the baby (a stealth step spawns it, story 4.9), or on a chore station (the chore system spawns it, story 9.5).

gag.description: The gag played on a miss (a `GAG_IDS` entry of the sim).

oneOf.description: A threat that stands on an anchor of the level, on Papa, on the baby, or on a chore station.

findMaxMs.description: From `SilenceStarted` to the surprise mischief if Papa has not found the baby, in sim ms.

surpriseGags.description: The gags a miss draws from, one at random (`world.rng`), never `papa_asleep`.

oneOf.description: A threat the baby hides: find him first, then Parry (GDD › Silence suspect).

description: A kind of threat: how it is telegraphed, answered and how it ends (GDD › Catalogue).
